newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Robotics offers videophone products.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Robotics offers videophone products.

text.p: U.S. Robotics Corp, already one of the nation's largest computer modem manufacturers, on Monday introduced a new line of products it says will make it easier for consumers to participate in two-way video communications.

The firm said it line of video communications products, dubbed Bigpicture, will give consumers a chance to make video telephone calls and send video e-mail. The Bigpicture system includes a video camera and image capturing card, a suite of video communications and video editing software.
U.S. Robotics said the Bigpicture package will sell for between $249 and $399 when it becomes available in December.
